scope: Offline replay only. No MuJoCo render, no new segmentation training, no test access for fitting or selection.
excluded_from_selection: Every train/test episode, including all round-2 and round-3 test episodes. Old test metadata may only be used for future split-overlap design.

fixed.pf_seed: original episode seed, paired across variants
fixed.observations: existing r3/obs-w6 and r3/oracle-w6, provenance checked; RGB cache vs teacher-label oracle separately
fixed.robust: unchanged empty block (no recovery or stuck injection)

diagnostics: Signed world-x and body-forward errors, load state, motion profile, speed, phase, doorway; per episode and pooled
Frame/evaluation/label time alignment and commanded-servo replay audit; equal-time frame precedes command
Issued-command duration vs integration steps; start/stop transient residuals
Teacher-supervised motion target vs gain/lag/delay on fitting dev only; held-out dev reports separately
Measurement-only likelihood around GT at deterministic every-10th settled door frame: x offsets -0.10..0.10 m, 0.01 m step, same y/yaw; oracle and vision; diagnostic only, never controller input

variants.description: VIS3 a1 unchanged; reuse complete baseline estimates with source hashes, verify regression on synthetic input
Expiry-aligned prediction and analytic first-order velocity integral with midpoint yaw; same M1 parameters
x1 plus dev-fitted default unloaded/loaded command gains, lag and nonnegative command delay; fine profile unchanged

fit_rule.targets: Body-frame displacement over timestamped teacher trajectory intervals (offline GT permitted only here)
fit_rule.gain: One output scale per axis multiplying the original M1 gain rows; robust through-origin fit clipped to [0.5, 1.5]
fit_rule.stop_tau_s: retain original M1 stop tau; default unloaded uses candidate spin-up tau
fit_rule.objective: Episode-balanced mean Huber loss of body velocity residual, delta [0.03,0.03,0.10] m/s,m/s,rad/s; at least 100 excited intervals per axis; fit moving teacher intervals, stationary commanded intervals reported as stuck diagnosis
fit_rule.moving_mask: body translation speed > 0.005 m/s OR abs yaw speed > 0.02 rad/s; exclude fine profile and profile/load transitions within 1.5 s
fit_rule.tie: lowest loss, then smaller delay, then smaller tau; no parameter refit using validation episodes

selection_rule.metrics: vision door_loaded position p90 P, abs lateral p99 L, yaw p90 Y; all-frame p90 A and lost frames (>0.30 m); report oracle alongside
selection_rule.eligibility: Against b0, on BOTH validation-only and all-dev: P <= b0.P+0.003 m; L <= b0.L+0.003 m; Y <= b0.Y+0.3 deg; A <= b0.A+0.02 m; lost <= b0.lost+ceil(0.01*n). Oracle all-dev P must not worsen by >0.005 m. Missing or partial episode is ineligible, never dropped.
selection_rule.improvement: Validation P improves by >=0.003 m AND all-dev P improves by >=0.003 m
selection_rule.rank: Among eligible improving candidates: lowest validation P, then L, then all-dev lost, then simpler x1 before m1. If none qualifies retain b0 and report negative result.
selection_rule.no_adaptive_grid: No further PF variants in this plan. Any follow-up requires a new pre-run file; no test selection. Do not relax physical gates to admit dev winner.

execution.source_freeze: sha256 snapshot of all runtime/analysis/config inputs before replay; no git commit per user
